definitions.D: Arbitrary real 2x2 matrix acting on Euclidean R2; no symmetry, normality, definiteness or diagonalizability assumption
definitions.euclidean_operator_norm: ||A||op=sup{||Av||2 : ||v||2=1}; equivalently the least nonnegative bound q such that ||Av||2 <= q||v||2 for every v, with equivalence justified rather than presumed for another norm
definitions.singular_values: Nonnegative square roots of the two real eigenvalues of D^T D, counted with multiplicity; must justify any norm/eigenvalue connection used
definitions.dA: Positive real sqrt(det D) only after determinant positivity is established; positivity is a target, not a supplied premise

admitted_assumptions: ||D-sI||op <= s eta under declared Euclidean operator norm
target: Conditional on the explicitly supplied majorization ||D-sI||<=s eta, eta<1, verify the 2x2 singular-value/determinant consequence s(1-eta)<=sqrt(detD)<=s(1+eta), with positive determinant branch.
required_scope: Universal arbitrary real 2x2 matrices satisfying the displayed norm premise
Two singular-value bounds and positive-determinant square-root consequence; determinant sign must be derived
Include eta=0 and nonsymmetric admissible matrices; eta=1 is excluded, not a caustic theorem
excluded: Jacobi solution existence and curvature-to-norm majorization
forbidden: Assuming determinant positivity, invertibility, singular-value bounds or the square-root target as premises
Replacing Euclidean induced operator norm with Frobenius, matrix row/column max norm, entrywise norm or indefinite Lorentzian norm
